title: PipelineDefinition
description: One versioned task-processing pipeline definition for a project. Source of truth on disk at <TaskRepository>/.metadata/pipelines/<projectId>/<version>.json, with a sibling current.json pointer. Mirrored into the derived pipeline-history.db for the editor history view and step_runs joins. Extends ADR-0045's TaskPipeline with the configurable common envelope and the llm/script step types. ADR-0051.

projectId.description: Canonical project id (PROJ-NNN, ADR-0042) this definition belongs to.

version.description: Monotonic definition version. Each save writes a new version; old versions are retained so a step_run can name the exact version it ran against.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC time this version was saved.

createdBy.description: Client identity id (client-identity.schema.json) that saved this version. Null for the boot-seeded default.

seeded.description: True for version 1 when it was seeded from PipelineCatalogue.Standard rather than authored by an operator.

pre.description: Ordered pre-processing steps (run before the core agent run).

post.description: Ordered post-processing steps (run after the core agent run).

step.description: One configurable step. The common envelope plus a type-specific body (command for script, model+prompt for llm).

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the definition.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the editor and timeline.

phase.description: Which phase this step belongs to. Core is the agent run and is not user-editable.

order.description: Sort key within the phase. Drag-to-reorder rewrites these.

type.description: Body discriminator. Llm = prompt + model, streams progress, produces a markdown artifact. Script = shell command, exit-code driven, captured output artifact.

kind.description: Internal implementation binding (ADR-0045 StepKind). Defaults: Script -> Tool, Llm -> Module (or Aspect for aspect-style reviews). Present so built-in steps keep their service binding.

failureMode.description: Hard fails the whole pipeline (gate); Soft records a warning and continues.

orchestratorReaction.description: Review = orchestrator makes an LLM judgement on the artifact (pass/reopen/escalate via ADR-0032). Scripted = deterministic pass/fail on the step's own result, no LLM.

enabled.description: When false the step is shown greyed in the timeline and skipped at runtime.

appliesTo.description: Repository stack required by the step. Applicability is derived from repository markers, never configured per project.

model.description: Llm steps only. Per-step model override via the shared selector (ASS-544/562). Null defers to job/project/client default.

cliType.description: Llm steps only. Optional per-step CLI override (claude/codex/copilot/gemini).

prompt.description: Llm steps only. The instruction for the step.

command.description: Script steps only. The shell command (e.g. 'dotnet build', 'npm run lint:scss').

timeoutMs.description: Optional wall-clock cap. On breach the step fails with reason 'timeout'.

dependsOn.description: Step ids within the same phase that must finish before this step starts. Empty means no intra-phase dependency; siblings with no edges may run in parallel (ADR-0045 bounded fan-out).
